facts.business: Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd provides environmental consulting, sustainability solutions, technology-driven environmental services, and laboratory testing services across sectors including environmental permitting, green building certification, social impact assessment, indoor air quality, and environmental monitoring.

guidance_or_targets.statement: aiming to sustain its historical profit ratios over time
TRL9 facility to unlock substantial, long-term revenue potential

key_risks: Recruiting experienced professionals in specialized environmental, sustainability, and technical domains remains competitive
Client concentration and high dependency of revenue on some clients
Geographical expansion to areas with limited operational experience may not be profitable
Dependencies from related-party transactions and partnerships
Lack of insurance for specific business risks
Defaults in obtaining, renewing or maintaining statutory and regulatory permits
Delays or defaults in payments from clients
Natural disasters, epidemics, pandemics, acts of war, terrorist attacks
Increasing collaborations with external organisations and resulting dependencies
Regulatory and statutory requirements of being a listed company
facts.related_party_note: The dependencies coming as a part and parcel of related-party transactions and partnerships could be a risk.
